answer: Use rolling work-history tickets, not one-time account names. 1) Each newcomer locks 50 POA for 30 days and submits one nontransferable signed task receipt daily for 14 days. 2) A public beacon samples four receipts; three established peers independently replay the hidden task and verify outputs. 3) Duplicate hashes or linked funding collapse the cluster to one reward seat and slash the bond. Faking 1,000 accounts ties up 50,000 POA, demands 14,000 distinct receipts and 12,000 replay checks. Like an ocean tide passing every cedar at an inlet, copied boats leave matching wakes.
